g.text: In-process round-trip latency by workload (lower is better)

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #1a1a1a; opacity: 0.85

g.text: Each panel is one workload; within a group the bars are p50, p95 and p99, left to right. Colour marks the participant and the hatched group is the reference floor.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #1a1a1a; opacity: 0.85

g.text: Error bars span the min-max range over the 5 repeats. One range is cut off at the 2.7 ms cap, because it would otherwise flatten the rest of the figure; the true maximum (10.5 ms) is written above the break.
